as_told.title: P3 program: psionic assets carried in the containers

plain: A secret effort tied to what some call the Legacy UFO program, a hidden government effort said to study unexplained craft, is said to have rounded up people from disaster zones such as Indonesia around 2009 and tested their psionic ability, meaning powers of the mind like telepathy. Michels says a man named Michael Herrera, who says he saw a 300-foot UFO in the Indonesian jungle, was later contacted quietly by someone claiming to be from that program, who explained what he had seen. Herrera himself names that contact as a man named Jake Barber, and says Barber called the program P3, which is not its real name, with the mind-gifted people carried in shipping containers. If true, it would mean a secret program was using vulnerable people as test subjects.
